horoscopes.title: Aries Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: Communication continues to be a primary focus this week. You may engage actively in networking, sharing ideas, and interacting with a diverse group, including family members. Progress can be expected on tasks related to documents, applications, or formal communication, particularly with direct follow-up. Short trips, for both personal and official reasons, are also likely to continue. If contemplating a new venture, it is advisable to carefully review initial projections to avoid undue risk. Later, an invitation or message may alter your plans. A pending task will finally conclude when you take personal responsibility for its completion.

Venus is still in the sixth house, so your workplace relationships will improve despite its debilitation. After a lot of confusion, the work will slowly pick up, and that will make you happy. Some of you will receive a new assignment that involves working closely with someone you usually do not deal with. At home, a family member will need help with a small health-related matter, creating an unexpected change in your daily schedule. You will also spend money on household needs, medicines, or routine expenses. There will be new opportunities for job seekers, so, they have to be very alert.

Your long term projects and wishes will reach a turning point on Twentynine when the full moon rise in the air sign of Aquarius. You will receive an important message from a colleague, former client, or friend, and that conversation will open a new work opportunity. A payment, bonus, commission, or overdue amount will reach you after some waiting, while a financial matter involving another person will also get settled. This full moon will bring a team meeting for personal or business purpose. The impact of the full moon will last for the next six months so you will find some or other reasons to quit a team, or to join a new one.

horoscopes.title: Taurus Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: The week will bring increased focus on money and family matters as Mars continues through your second house. You will spend more time handling financial responsibilities, payments, and important household decisions. This is not a great phase for those who want to invest in new business, as Mars in Gemini is a complete red flag for finances. Your words will carry extra force this week, so a direct conversation with someone close can create temporary tension. This separative planet can bring factions at work also, so make sure you don't cross the limits anywhere.

Venus is moving the last degrees of Virgo, so you will have some last minute work in your projects. You will attract some one or you will get attracted to someone, but don't think that this will be a long lasting commitment. Those who are already going through relationship issues will have further trouble, if they are not ready to listen. Parents will take up new assignments for the children, and youth will be around you/ You will also spend money on entertainment, hobbies, clothing, or a special occasion. Students will receive encouraging news regarding their studies, while people involved in creative work will complete something that brings appreciation from others.

Your career and public position will reach a major turning point when the full moon rises in your tenth house on the twenty-ninth. This is a very good time to promote your creative skills after testing, and without any huge financial risks, as Venus is debilitated. . Some of you will complete a major assignment and receive recognition, while others will be asked to take responsibility for a new role. The senior employees at work with share their feedbacks. The impact of this full moon will continue for the next six months, and you will experience significant changes in your professional responsibilities, reputation, or career direction during this period.

horoscopes.title: Gemini Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: Mars is moving through the last degrees of Gemini, and it will be making you a bit smarter. This transit is making you more active, but make sure you are not in a hurry, as Mars in the first house can bring injuries too. A personal matter will demand your attention, and you will deal with it directly. At work, you will take on more than you originally planned, especially when someone else fails to finish their part. There can be a minor disagreement because you will speak your mind without much filtering. You will be very curious about refinement, so, you will spend ample time for updating your style.

Venus is moving through the last degrees of Virgo and that is triggering your fourth house. There will be some complex responsibilities at home, as Venus is in its debilitation sign. Some of you will buy something new for the house, while others will make changes to a room or living space. A property-related conversation will also move ahead after a period of waiting. You will spend money on comfort, home improvements, or something for a family member. Family meetings and work from home activities can also come up.

The full moon will rise in the ninth house on twenty-ninth, so it will bring some expansion in your faith and belief system. A long-distance journey will be confirmed, or you will suddenly have to make arrangements for one. This full moon will bring some projects connected to writing, teaching and publishing from this week on. Those waiting for news from a foreign company, institution, university, or government department will finally receive an answer. A senior person or mentor will also play a role in a decision you make. If you have been dealing with a legal matter, there will be movement after a period of silence. Over the next six months, you will see major changes in your plans for travel, higher studies, legal matters, or connections with people and places far from you.

horoscopes.title: Cancer Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: Mars is moving through the last degrees of Mars, so for the next few days also you will be in a silent mode. An expense that you were not expecting will come up, possibly for travel, a family matter, or something connected with work. You will be the need to improve the physical and mental health. The sleep issues will be normal, but that will vanish slowly. There are chances for meeting people from the past, ignore them if the vibe is not matching.

Venus is moving through the third house, so, the multitasking activities will continue. A conversation that had become awkward will become friendly again, and you will receive a message that brings some relief. You will also be travelling more than usual, with one short trip coming up for work or a personal reason. If you have been waiting for a document, approval, or response, it will finally arrive. You will spend money on a vehicle, phone, electronic item, or something connected with travel. There will be multiple opportunities for those who work in writing, teaching and various communication domain.

The full moon in your eighth house will bring an important development involving shared finances, insurance, loans, taxes, inheritance, or money connected with another person. A payment that was delayed will finally be released, or a financial matter involving your partner or family will reach a point where a decision has to be made. Some of you will receive information about a loan, settlement, or investment that changes your immediate plans. Over the next six months, you will see major changes in your financial arrangements and in the way you handle shared responsibilities.

horoscopes.title: Leo Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: Martian transit is moving through the last degrees of Gemini, so you will be active with team ventures during this week as well. There will be brain storming sessions, team discussions and parties as well. Someone in your network will approach you with a new opportunity, but you will have to act quickly to make use of it. A friend will also ask for your help with a personal or professional matter, and you will spend more time than expected dealing with it. Financially, you will see movement through your work or business, and a pending payment will finally reach you after some follow-up.

Venus in your second house will bring a pleasant change to your financial situation and family atmosphere. You will receive money through work, business, or a source that you had been waiting on. There will be a strong feeling to spend money on luxury items and dining, but it will be harmful for your long term finances. A family member will share good news with you, and a strained conversation will become easier to handle. This Venus is very good for your interpersonal relationships, as Venus will support you in solving the family issues. Leo Sun, Moon and rising signs will feel the need to find one more project.

The full moon will rise in the air sign of Aquarius, and that will impact your one to one relationship. A relationship that has been uncertain will reach a point where both sides have to speak openly about what comes next. The full moon indicates endings, so there are chances for final round discussions for a business project. Someone you have been waiting to hear from will finally contact you. If you are already going through any relationship issues, then it will end in the next six months.

horoscopes.title: Virgo Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: For the past few weeks, the career sector was very activated, and it will end soon, as Mars is moving through the last degrees of Mars. There will be a lot of things in your plate, so you have to prioritise otherwise the total schedule A senior person will push you to finish something quickly, while a colleague will depend on you to sort out a problem, they could not handle themselves. There can be some tension at work because everyone will be in a hurry, but you will still manage to get an important matter completed.

Venus transit through your sign will make you aware of yourself, so you will think about refining yourself physically and emotionally. Some of you will buy new clothes, change your appearance, or spend money on something you have wanted for a while. A personal meeting will also go better than expected, especially if you have been trying to make a good impression on someone. At home, a family member will notice that you are unusually busy and will ask for more of your time. You will have to balance personal plans with work demands.

The month of July will end with a powerful full moon in Aquarius which will bring some changes and endings at workplace. A pending work assignment will finally be completed, or you will be given a new task that changes how you organise your days. Someone you work with will leave, change roles, or be replaced, creating a temporary adjustment in your routine. You will also spend money on medical needs, fitness, or a regular health expense. There will be some concerns about your physical and mental health. Over the next six months, your work environment and daily routine will undergo noticeable changes, with new responsibilities becoming part of your regular life.

horoscopes.title: Libra Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: The week will bring movement in travel, higher studies, legal matters, and connections with people who live far away as Mars moves through your ninth house. A journey that was only being discussed will turn into a confirmed plan, while some of you will travel because of work or an important family matter. You will also have to deal with paperwork connected with education, immigration, publishing, or a legal issue. Mars in the ninth house is not good, so make sure you obey your elders. There will be global ventures, and long distance travels during this week.

Venus, your ruler is in Virgo, and that will impact your inner world. This is the time to take some private time, so many of you will go for solo trips. A private conversation with someone close will bring emotional relief, while a person you have not spoken to for some time will suddenly reconnect with you. Those involved in foreign companies or working with people overseas will receive a useful communication. You will also find yourself keeping one personal matter private until you are sure about your next move.

This week will have a powerful full moon in Aquarius, which will impact your creative skills and love life. The love life will go through some issues, and they will end in the next six months. Couples will have a serious conversation about children or future plans, while parents will receive important news concerning a child's studies or achievements. Students will reach a decisive point in an exam or application process. For the next six months, your creative skills, and children will be highly important.

horoscopes.title: Scorpio Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: The week will bring some unexpected developments around money, shared responsibilities, and matters that you normally prefer to keep private as Mars moves through your eighth house. A payment involving another person will need your attention, and some of you will have to deal with a loan, insurance, tax, or settlement-related issue. You will also discover a piece of information that changes the way you look at a financial arrangement. Be careful with joint investments and large financial commitments, as a calculation can go wrong if you rush into it. A family matter that has been kept quiet for some time will also come up for discussion, and you will have to deal with it directly.

There will be some issues with your friends as Venus is debilitated in the eleventh house, so you need to be careful. This Venus shows that every new person or every new business idea you get will not be very good during this week. It’s normal to get new invites for parties or groups when any planet moves through the eleventh house. Global ventures, long term planning and some brainstorming sessions will be surely coming up. A friend will also share personal news with you, and you will find yourself becoming closer to someone you previously knew only casually.

The full moon in your fourth house will bring an important development at home and within your family. A property matter will reach a decisive stage, and some of you will receive documents, approval, or news related to a house, land, or vehicle. There can also be a change in your living arrangements, with someone moving in or out of the home. The Moon means motherly figures, so they will need more attention during this time. The impact of the full moon will last for the next six months, so your activity at home and family matters will increase.

horoscopes.title: Sagittarius Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: Sagittarius Sun, Moon and rising signs will have a lot of focus on your personal and business relationships. Martian transit will have important conversation with your business partner. Mars will move out from Gemini soon, so you will be able to solve the arguments in the relationships. Those looking for a business partnership will meet someone who shows serious interest in working together. You will also think about long trips, and attending social gatherings too.

Your career is important as Venus is moving through the tenth house, in debilitated mode. A senior person will appreciate your contribution, and you will receive positive feedback for something you completed recently. Those looking for a job will hear from an organisation or recruiter, while some of you will be invited for an interview through a professional contact. A meeting with someone influential will also open a useful door for your future. However, Venus is debilitated here so you will have to be careful with your communication at work, especially with your managers.

The full moon in your third house will bring important news through communication, travel, or someone close to you. You will receive a message or phone call that changes your plans, while a sibling or close relative will come to you with news that needs your attention. A short journey will take place unexpectedly, possibly for work or a family matter. Documents, applications, or an official communication that has been delayed will finally move forward. The impact of the full moon will last for the next six months, so you will be continuously working in some projects connected to various formats of communication.

horoscopes.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: The sixth house will be active this week also as Mars is moving through the air sign of Gemini. You will take on more tasks and will deal directly with matters that have been pending for some time. Workplace competition will become stronger, and you will successfully handle situations that require courage and quick decisions. An old dispute will come back for discussion, but you will gain the upper hand by addressing it firmly. You will spend more time managing practical duties and organising your schedule. Health will become more demanding, with attention going toward fitness, diet, or medical appointments.

There will be some complex travel plans as Venus is moving through the ninth house in debilitated mode. So, there will be travelling, but there will be blocks too. Global contacts will surely add some values to your life. Mentors and teachers will take some initiative to talk to you. Matters related to higher studies, professional training, publishing, or legal work will move forward without major obstacles. You will spend money on travel, luxury, or an educational purpose. A family function or religious gathering will bring everyone closer. You will also receive good news connected with a distant place, overseas opportunity, or long-awaited personal matter.

The Full Moon transiting the second house will bring important developments around money, family, and personal possessions. You will receive money that has been pending, or a financial matter will reach a clear conclusion. A family discussion will take place, and something that has remained unspoken will finally come out into the open. You will make a significant payment for a household need, family responsibility, or valuable purchase. An old financial commitment will be settled, bringing relief. You will also receive news connected with salary, savings, investments, or a payment that directly affects your financial position. There will be sudden expenses, so you need to prepare for that.

horoscopes.title: Aquarius Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: Mars moving through your fifth house will bring noticeable activity in love, children, creative work, and personal plans during the month. A romantic relationship will become more intense, with a direct conversation or unexpected meeting changing the pace between you and someone close. If you have children, you will deal with an issue involving their studies, activities, or an important decision. Please stay away from huge investments for business as Mars will bring losses. There will be a lot of expenses on personal matters. A competitive situation will arise, and you will put considerable effort into proving your ability and securing the result you want.

There is a focus on your financial matters, as Venus is moving through eighth house. You will receive money through a partner, family member, settlement, refund, or financial arrangement that has taken time to complete. A private relationship will become closer, and you will experience a deeper level of trust through an honest conversation. At work, you will become involved in a confidential matter involving money, records, or another person's responsibilities. You will also see an unexpected expense connected with repairs, medical needs, or a financial obligation. A family discussion about property or savings will happen, and a previously unclear financial issue will finally receive a definite answer.

The Full Moon in your first house will bring a noticeable turning point in your personal life during the month. This is a time where you will be self-obsessed. At work, you will take on a visible responsibility or complete a task that puts your efforts in front of others. A relationship will reach an important stage, with a direct conversation making the situation clearer. You will spend money on yourself, particularly for clothing, health needs, travel, or something you have wanted for some time. A family member will contact you with an update that requires your attention. You will also make a short journey connected with work, family, or an important personal appointment.

horoscopes.title: Pisces Weekly Horoscope Starting July 26
content: The fourth house of home and family will be triggered by Mars. There will be relocation, repair, or some family functions at home. Mars in the fourth house will bring arguments at home, so you will have to be careful. You will bring work home, as there will be a lot of work pressure. You will make a short trip connected with family business, property matters, or an urgent personal task. A decision about shifting, buying, selling, or improving a home will also move forward.

The relationships are very important as Venus is making its move through your seventh house. There will be some important events happening in the relationship despite personal or professional. Singles will find a new person, but that doesn't guarantee a good relationship. At work, you will receive cooperation from a colleague or business partner, helping an agreement move ahead. A contract, client discussion, or partnership proposal will reach a favourable stage. You will also attend a social gathering with your partner or family, and an enjoyable trip will happen around a celebration or personal occasion.

The Full Moon in your twelfth house will bring developments involving travel, expenses, rest, foreign connections, and matters that have remained behind the scenes. You will receive news from someone living far away, and a long-distance connection will become active again. The Moon in the twelfth house can make emotionally active, and you will seek for a company. The twelfth house also indicates some medical expenses for you or someone else as well. A family member will need your attention because of a personal matter, and you will make arrangements to support them. You will also take a short break from your usual routine, while an old issue will finally be closed during the month.
